info.title: Megadex — user management, preferences and lookups
info.description:
Megadex API, reached through Gatelin (Traefik `/api` → Gatelin → megadex), which authenticates the caller and injects the `x-consumer-*` headers.

**How to try it.** Call `POST /gatelin/sessions` with a dev user, then click **Authorize** and paste the `accessToken`.

**Dev credentials.** The `__EMAIL_<userId>__` / `__PWD_<userId>__` placeholders are replaced by `scripts/setup-mocks.sh` after it seeds the dev users' passwords in Foxnox. If you still see literal placeholders, run `scripts/setup-mocks.sh`.

preferenceResourcePath.description: Admin table the preferences belong to

socialsJsonAgg.description: Handles keyed by social network name (see `/megadex/socials`). Sending the property replaces all handles; blank values drop the entry; an unknown network is rejected.

resourceName.description: Admin table the preference applies to

conf.description: Column configuration of the table view

locked.description: Built-in template shared by all users. Editing one forks a personal copy.

isActive.description: Select this preference for the calling user

searchRequest.description: Common body for every `POST /<entity>/search` route. All fields optional. `filters` is a per-column map: `{ <column>: { value, matchMode } }`.

pagination.description: When true, the response includes `total` = matching row count (before pagination)

filters.description: Map of column name to filter clause. See `antity-pgsql` for the full matchMode grammar.

record.description: JSON snapshot of the affected row

auditEntry.description: One row of `log.audit` with raw snapshots converted into a human-readable `changes` summary.

changes.description: Formatted field diffs (with secret/private fields redacted)

entityProperty.description: One row of the metadata returned by `GET /<entity>/schema`. Private properties are filtered out at that endpoint.

badRequestError.description: Missing or invalid parameters in body / path / query

unauthorizedError.description: Password mismatch or missing/invalid access token

post.summary: Log in (Gatelin) and get an access token

get.summary: Authenticated user basics (used by the admin)

put.description: Self-service profile update for the authenticated consumer (`x-consumer-user-id`). Allows updating profile fields (`firstName`, `lastName`, `nickname`, `backupEmail`, `language`, `portrait`, `socialsJsonAgg`, etc.) while rejecting privilege-escalation fields (`roles`, `active`, `archived`, `email`) with `403`.

post.description: Creates user profile(s) in Megadex. When `PWD_CREATE_URL` is configured, also provisions each created user's password record in Foxnox (`POST /foxnox/pwd`) so the user can complete onboarding via Foxnox's password recovery flow (`/api/foxnox/web/recover`).

Requires trusted consumer identity and the restoreUsers permission at Gatelin. Restores profiles only; passwords and sessions remain archived. IDs are validated and deduplicated; extra row fields are ignored. Uses an audited update, including for already-active rows.

200.description: Restore completed, including when no row matches
